LanguageData.Gun_Carl_Gustav_M45_RWP.label: Carl Gustav M/45
LanguageData.Gun_Carl_Gustav_M45_RWP.description: The Carl Gustav M/45, a Swedish submachine gun known for its simplicity and reliability, is a versatile firearm with moderate range and a high rate of fire. Ideal for close combat, its robust design ensures it can withstand even the harshest conditions. Used by various military forces, it remains a trusted choice for those needing a dependable automatic weapon.
